issues: PR #22, backend/src/errors/ragErrors.ts: embeddingDimensionMismatchError(expectedDimension, actualDimension) passes { expectedDimension, actualDimension } as the AppError's `details`. ADR-5 scopes `details` to 'field-level validation errors (arrives in E4)' only, and design.md's own preamble lists ADR-5 ('internals never echoed') as a standing convention this sprint must not re-litigate. This is a 500 EMBEDDING_DIMENSION_MISMATCH (our own bug per ADR-12, not user input, and not a field-validation error), and backend/src/middleware/errorHandler.ts echoes `details` verbatim into the JSON response whenever it's set (`...(details !== undefined && { details })`), regardless of status code. So every dimension-mismatch response leaks internal vector-dimension state to the caller. The sibling error added one ticket earlier in the same file, embeddingFailedError (E3-T01), explicitly avoids this and says why in its own doc comment: 'nothing Voyage-shaped is carried in details (ADR-5, ADR-13)'. Required fix: drop the `details` argument from the AppError constructed in embeddingDimensionMismatchError (the function can still take expectedDimension/actualDimension for a server-side log line if useful, but must not put them on the AppError that reaches the client). Update the two call sites in vectorIndex.service.ts if the factory's signature changes.

Everything else reviewed clean: PR #21 (sessionState.service.ts) matches ADR-15 exactly — get-or-create/read-without-creating/clear-one/clear-all, reads verified not to allocate, module-level singleton reset for tests. PR #22's vectorIndex.service.ts correctly implements ADR-12 (defensive unit-normalisation at both insert and query time, zero-magnitude vectors rejected via AppError.internal consistent with embedding.service.ts's existing pattern, dimension consistency enforced across both the existing index and a new batch before any mutation happens, top-K + minRelevanceScore filtering is descending via `>=` threshold / sort / slice, cross-session isolation is structural since every function resolves through sessionState.service.ts for the caller's own session id only). Branch basing (PR #21 stacking on E3-T01's unmerged branch tip) is consistent with how T01's own three PRs stacked, and both PR descriptions explain the reasoning. Verified the merge-base of each stacked branch pair matches the expected parent tip. Full suite (119 tests) green and typecheck clean on PR #22's branch tip. Once the details leak above is fixed, this is otherwise ready to approve — no other changes requested.
